collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official OpenCode Go plan page and docs page (English). Official pricing tables only.
scope: OpenCode Go official price table only. No leaderboard/score data, no Command Goat, no shared-pool changes, no other OpenCode rows.

adopted.cacheWriteNote: No cache-write price listed in the official table.

limitedTime4xNotAdopted.reason: CONVENTIONS requires every temporary promotion to carry an end date. The page shows a 4x (→ $60) limited-time multiplier with no deadline, so it is recorded here as evidence only and is not used for the adopted row.
limitedTime4xNotAdopted.impact: Adopted monthly credit stays at the steady-state $15; monthlyYi would be ~4.428 if and when the 4x promotion is confirmed with a deadline.
limitedTime4xNotAdopted.landingPageQuote: Step 5 Preview is now available in Go with 4× usage for a limited time.

priorFreeNotAdopted.label: Step 5 Preview Free
priorFreeNotAdopted.reason: A free unlimited limited-time entry carries no monetary allowance, so it was never turned into an adopted point. The 2026-10-16 paid row is the first measured point for this model on OpenCode Go.
priorFreeNotAdopted.impact: Creates the first adopted opencode_go row for step-5-preview at monthlyYi 1.107.

officialRequestEstimates.note: Official 'Estimated requests' table for the Go plan (https://opencode.ai/docs/go/, re-checked 2026-10-16); used only as cross-check evidence, never as the allowance main value. The page shows the $15 tier struck through and the 4x tier in bold.
officialRequestEstimates.crossCheck: Official per-request workload for Step 5 Preview = 1,000 input + 55,000 cached + 200 output → $0.001 + $0.0055 + $0.00054 = $0.00704; 2,130 × $0.00704 = $15.0 (matches the $15 Usage). 5h ≈ 20% and week ≈ 50% of the monthly figure, matching the page's per-model 5h/weekly/monthly = 20%/50%/100% rule.
officialRequestEstimates.correction: The first draft of this file recorded per5h 430 / perWeek 1720 / perMonth 1070, mixing the two tiers; corrected before merge.
